_comment: Roadmap of The Silver Void. Edit this file to update the Roadmap window: set "done": true on an item to tick it, "state" of a phase can be done, now, next or later. bold is allowed in texts.

items.text: The Ritual: burn zkLTC, climb four ranks
The Arena: staked duels, settled on-chain
Relics: on-chain draws, and the Forge
The Lower City: an NFT marketplace open to every LitVM collection
The Codex, ring skins, feats and the soulbound badges of the Order
The Chronicles: Fragments I to VI
New contracts written and tested: every burn credited through one Ritual, an on-chain minimum per offering, royalties
Weekly quests in preview
Bot protection: dust offerings no longer count
Public testing of the mainnet version
External security audit
Deployment on LitVM mainnet
Weekly quests with rewards: a bonus relic draw
The Path: new Chronicles fragments unlock as the community burns
A simple integration guide for builders who want to burn through the Void
The Chronicles continue: a journey across the seven kingdoms
The Chronicles in print: an illustrated edition, to carry the story beyond the screen
The Void as a shared sink: any LitVM dApp can burn for its users, and their rank grows wherever they play
Partnerships with launchpads and token creators, so new projects plug into the Void from day one
New relic series and ring skins
New ways to play, always built around the burn
